literal: Destroying is necessary the five's sense-domain; leaving is necessary desired all together.
translation: One must conquer the domain of the five senses. To do so, one must give up all desired things altogether.
modern: ஐம்புலன்களின் ஆசைகளை அழிக்க வேண்டும்; அதற்கு நாம் விரும்பிய பொருட்கள் அனைத்தையும் ஒருசேர விட்டுவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the fundamental requirement of renunciation. To achieve true detachment, one must conquer the domain of the five senses, which constantly pull the mind toward worldly objects. To succeed in this, it is necessary to completely and simultaneously give up all things one desires. The word 'ஒருங்கு' (altogether) stresses that partial renunciation is insufficient; all attachments must be abandoned at once.
